title: Swimmers & Children in Ocean Waves, 1956 Summer Beach B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A lively mid-century black-and-white snapshot featuring children and adults wading and riding the waves in the ocean surf during a sunny beach outing. The swimmers are dressed in classic 1950s one-piece and two-piece bathing suits. The photograph has scalloped deckled edges and carries a photographic processing border date of August 1956.
